SIPALG::nonregister_subscriber_listener
Description
This iRules command gets or sets the value of flag enabling creating an ephemeral listener for nonregistered
subscribers. Returns 0 or 1.
Syntax
SIPALG
::
nonregister_subscriber_listener
[
boolean
]
Examples
when
SIP_REQUEST
{
log
local0.
"nonregister_subscriber_listener is [SIPALG::nonregister_subscriber_listener]"
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
CLIENT_ACCEPTED, SERVER_CONNECTED, SIP_REQUEST, SIP_REQUEST_SEND, SIP_RESPONSE, SIP_RESPONSE_SEND
Introduced: BIGIP-15.0
